title: Mortgage income-tax refund
intro: Armenia refunds the personal income tax you pay, up to the mortgage interest you pay, up to a cap each quarter. The scheme is being withdrawn province by province, so where you buy decides whether you get anything at all.

form.quarterlyIncomeTax: Income tax you pay per quarter, AMD
form.quarterlyIncomeTaxHint: The refund can never exceed this. Roughly three months of the tax withheld from your pay.
form.lenderIsResident: The lender is an Armenian financial institution
form.paysArmenianIncomeTax: I pay Armenian personal income tax
form.failed: The calculation could not be completed.

purchaseKind.FROM_STATE_OR_COMMUNITY: From the state or the community
purchaseKind.SELF_BUILT: I built it myself, under a permit

result.effectiveRate: Your {nominal}% mortgage behaves like a {effective}% one
result.assumption: The total assumes you keep paying this much income tax every quarter for {years, plural, one {# year} other {# years}}. The refund shrinks as the interest does.
result.wouldHaveBeen: Had it qualified, it would have refunded up to {amount} a quarter.
result.ruleSet: Calculated with rule set {version}, the one in force on the agreement date.

ineligible.agreementTooEarly: The scheme only covers agreements signed on or after {minAgreementDate}.
ineligible.phasedOut: The scheme ended in {marz} for agreements signed on or after {phaseOutDate}. Designated border settlements are exempt.
ineligible.propertyTooExpensive: The property is worth more than the {maxPropertyValueAmd} ceiling the rules allow.
ineligible.notEligiblePurchase: Only newly built housing bought from the developer, the state or the community, or a home you built yourself under a permit, qualifies.
ineligible.lenderNotResident: The loan has to come from a resident Armenian financial institution.
ineligible.notAnArmenianTaxpayer: The refund is of Armenian personal income tax, so you have to pay it.
ineligible.applicantTooOld: The rules in force set an age limit of {maxApplicantAge}.
ineligible.noRulesForDate: No rules are recorded for an agreement dated {agreementDate}.

disclaimer: An estimate from publicly available information, not tax advice. Confirm your entitlement with the State Revenue Committee before you rely on it.
